text:
Fixed and verified.

Root cause confirmed exactly as filed: ControlTransition keyed observation and accounting lookups on whole-JobRef equality, while SlurmParsers.scala:139 rewrites the observation's ref to carry the reported cluster. A bound attempt with cluster = None never matched a report with cluster = Some(...).

Scope was wider than the bead described: recordAccounting (ControlTransition.scala:469-471) had the IDENTICAL defect, and that is the worse of the two because accounting is the path that produces terminal outcomes — so the attempt never terminated either. reconcileBinding (:412) compared `existing == job`, which would have fallen through to InvalidPhase on a cluster-only difference.

Fix:
- core/FailureModel.scala: added JobKey (jobId + arrayIndex) plus JobRef.key and JobRef.clusterConflictsWith. Cluster is evidence, not identity; two KNOWN and differing clusters are genuinely different jobs and never match.
- managed/ControlTransition.scala: recordObservations, recordAccounting and activeBound now match on JobKey; reconcileBinding compares keys. A genuine cluster conflict yields ManagedObservation.Unavailable / ManagedAccounting.Unavailable carrying diagnostic code observation-cluster-conflict / accounting-cluster-conflict with boundCluster and reportedCluster fields — refused, but never silent.

Also collapsed the rule to one place. It had been spelled four different ways: cli/SlurmCliScheduler.identity returned an ad-hoc (JobId, Option[ArrayIndex]) tuple, and ssh/RemoteTask.scala:245 and ssh/RemoteBatch.scala:506 each open-coded the same two-field comparison. All now use JobRef.key. Those three SSH/CLI sites were already CORRECT — the managed path was the only live break.

Verification (P6f.28-P6f.39 standard):
- New modules/managed/src/test/.../ClusterAttributionSuite.scala, 3 tests. Demonstrated RED against the parent commit: "Failed: Total 3, Failed 3, Errors 0, Passed 0".
- After the fix: 3/3 pass; full suite 308 tests (305 + 3 new), 0 failed.
- scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck clean.

Note for P8.D4: this is the semantics-only hotfix. The structural change (removing cluster from JobRef and demoting it to evidence, declaring federation unsupported) remains D4's job. JobKey is the seam that change will use.
